{"sample_id":"irssi-theme-load-lone-tag-escape","fine_trace":[{"step":1,"file":"src/fe-fuzz/fe-common/core/theme-load.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":61,"var":"copy","code":"gchar *copy = g_strndup((const gchar *)data, size);","role":"source","note":"The fuzz input bytes are copied into a NUL-terminated theme file payload that drives parsing."},{"step":2,"file":"src/fe-fuzz/fe-common/core/theme-load.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":68,"var":"copy","code":"fwrite(copy, strlen(copy), 1, fp);","role":"intermediate","note":"The copied input is written verbatim to fuzz.theme, preserving the attacker-controlled escape sequences."},{"step":3,"file":"src/fe-common/core/themes.c","function":"theme_load","line":957,"var":"theme_read(theme, theme->path)","code":"if (!theme_read(theme, theme->path)) {","role":"intermediate","note":"Loading the theme file transfers control into the theme parser on the attacker-controlled file contents."},{"step":4,"file":"src/fe-common/core/themes.c","function":"theme_format_expand_data_rec","line":492,"var":"*format == '\\' && p[1] != '\\0'","code":"if (*p == '\\' && p[1] != '\\0') {","role":"root_cause","note":"The parser only treats a backslash as an escape when it is followed by another byte, so a lone trailing escape is not consumed as a terminator and parsing continues past the intended boundary."},{"step":5,"file":"src/fe-common/core/themes.c","function":"theme_format_expand_data_rec","line":495,"var":"expand_escape(&p)","code":"chr = expand_escape(&p);","role":"sink","note":"The escape-expansion path consumes the next byte after the backslash and can mis-handle a lone tag escape, producing incorrect parsing behavior."}],` executed with exit code -1.
